SELECT quiz_attempts.question_id FROM quiz_attempts JOIN quiz_sessions ON quiz_attempts.session_id = quiz_sessions.id WHERE quiz_attempts.user_id = $1::BIGINT AND quiz_sessions.mode_code = $2::VARCHAR ORDER BY quiz_attempts.answered_at DESC

SELECT energy_state.user_id, energy_state.free_energy, energy_state.paid_energy, energy_state.free_cap, energy_state.regen_interval_sec, energy_state.last_regen_at, energy_state.last_daily_topup_local_date, energy_state.version, energy_stat
UPDATE users SET last_seen_at=$1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE users.id = $2::BIGINT
UPDATE energy_state SET free_energy=$1::SMALLINT, version=$2::INTEGER, updated_at=$3::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE energy_state.user_id = $4::BIGINT
